extensionDescription.message: Attach large files to your emails as FileSender download links.

errNotConfigured.message: FileSender is not configured: open the account settings and enter base URL, username and API key.

errInsecureUrl.message: FileSender is configured with an insecure http:// address: open the account settings and use https://.

errAuth.message: FileSender authentication failed: check username and API key in the account settings.

errTooLarge.message: The file exceeds the maximum size allowed by this FileSender instance.

errFileName.message: The file name contains characters not allowed by this FileSender instance. Rename the file and try again.

errNoUrl.message: Upload completed, but FileSender did not return a download link.

mgmtLead.message: Enter your credentials to send large files as FileSender download links.

mgmtBaseUrlHint.message: The address of your FileSender instance. /rest.php is appended automatically if missing.

mgmtUsernameHint.message: The "username" value in the filesender.py.ini file you can download from your FileSender profile. It is often not your email address.

mgmtEmailHint.message: Sender (from) of the transfers. Leave it empty to use the main email of your FileSender account; if you set it, it must be one of the emails of that account.

mgmtApikeyHint.message: The "API secret" shown on your FileSender profile page.

mgmtRequired.message: Fill in base URL, username and API key.

mgmtInvalidEmail.message: Enter a valid sender email address.

mgmtInsecureUrl.message: Use a secure https:// address; http:// is not allowed here.

mgmtSaved.message: Saved. FileSender is ready to use.

errAupNotAccepted.message: The terms of use of the service have not been accepted: open the account settings.

errEmptyFile.message: The file is empty: FileSender does not accept empty files.

mgmtAup.message: I accept the terms and conditions of this service

mgmtAupHint.message: You can read them on the upload page of the service:

mgmtAupRequired.message: You must accept the terms of use of the service.

mgmtDaysHint.message: Maximum allowed by this instance: $N$ days.

mgmtInstanceUnavailable.message: Cannot read the configuration of the instance: check the base URL.

optEmailUploadComplete.message: Notify me when the upload is complete

optEmailReportOnClosing.message: Send me a report when it expires

optMustBeLoggedIn.message: Recipients must log in to FileSender to download the files

ntfReuploadChanged.message: $FILE$ has changed: the file is uploaded again.

ntfReuploadInvalid.message: The previous link for $FILE$ is no longer valid: the file is uploaded again.

ntfOptionsIgnored.message: FileSender did not apply some options for $FILE$: $LIST$.

errEncryptionMandatory.message: This FileSender instance requires encryption: enable "Ask for the upload options at every upload" in the account settings.

errEncryptionUnsupported.message: Encryption is not available on this FileSender instance.

errPasswordInvalid.message: The password does not meet the requirements of this FileSender instance.

mgmtAskOptions.message: Ask for the upload options (expiry, notifications, encryption) at every upload

mgmtAskOptionsHint.message: A small window opens before each upload, prefilled with the options below. If disabled, uploads start immediately with these options and encryption is not available.

optEncrypt.message: Encrypt the files with a password

optPasswordWarning.message: Send the password to the recipients separately (not in this email). It is not saved anywhere and cannot be recovered.

errFileExtension.message: The file extension $EXT$ is not allowed by this FileSender instance.

reuseText.message: This file was already uploaded, but its link expires on $WHEN$, in less than 24 hours.

reuseEncrypted.message: The link is encrypted: recipients need the same password as before.

mgmtCredentialsInvalid.message: FileSender rejected the credentials: check username and API key.

mgmtTestOk.message: Connection OK: FileSender accepted the credentials.

errBadEmail.message: The sender email is not one of the emails of your FileSender account: fix it or leave it empty in the account settings.

mgmtTestOkFilled.message: Connection OK. Default options were filled in from your FileSender profile: check them, accept the terms and save.

reuseTextValid.message: This file was already uploaded with encryption; its link is valid until $WHEN$.

cleanupNote.message: Files uploaded for an email are deleted from FileSender if you remove the attachment or close the email without sending it or saving it as a draft. Links that were reused, sent or saved are never deleted.

mgmtDebugHint.message: Applies to all FileSender accounts. Tokens, signatures, keys and email addresses are always masked. Errors are logged anyway.
